title: Tokens Are Snacks
goal: Every word costs a snack. Use just enough — don't gobble them all!
mascot_lines: Robots eat little snacks called TOKENS.
Short and clear messages save snacks for later!
Pick the better way to ask.

choices.label: 📝 Make a star, blue, big, on the right side, but actually maybe small, hmm
📚 Read the whole library and pick something
🎤 Tell me everything you know about everything
